test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: english
question:
There is an underlined segment in the given sentence. Select the most appropriate option to substitute the segment. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.

I like Rahane’s style of batting __**more than Kohli**__.
solution:
The correct answer is **"more than Kohli"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence in the question has done the wrong comparison.
 
• Look at the sentence:
 
 
• I like Rahane’s style of batting more than Kohli__.
 
 
 
• It compared Rahane's style of batting to Kohli, you can't compare an adverb (style) to a noun (Kohli).
 
• Look at the following examples:
 __
 
• My car is more expensive than Elena. (wrong)
 
• My car is more expensive than the car of Elena (right)
 
 
 
• Hence the correct answer is: *I like Rahane’s style of batting more than Kohli's __*
